metricPrompts.M01:
Metric M01 is semantic coverage of the assigned authoritative obligation in the candidate requirement decomposition. Search the whole candidate for equivalent meaning, including genuine cross-references; matching IDs or headings alone is insufficient, and equivalent paraphrases need no original IDs. Account for all mandatory behaviors and applicable conditions, exceptions, limits and prohibitions from the frozen basis. Do not assess implementation, execution, acceptance-criterion quality or unrelated objects. PASS requires coverage of the entire assigned obligation; a concrete missing or weakened obligation supports DEVIATION. Use UNVERIFIED when unavailable evidence prevents this comparison, not merely because application code or runtime results are absent. Cite the candidate content that supports the decision and identify a specific coverage gap when one exists.
First establish the proof subject for this metric. task.targetFiles and targetPrefixes are navigation/citation boundaries, not a declaration that a listed file is the candidate. Identify actual candidate requirement-decomposition units from their content and task authority. A control configuration, original requirements or Skill, application code, or execution record does not become a candidate decomposition merely because it is listed, readable, or mentions the obligation. Candidate units may exist in an existing file or original message; no new document or format is required. The subject here is represented requirements, not whether described implementation or process actions actually happened. Use inherited process-audit guidance only to understand the obligation being represented; do not turn an M01 coverage check into an audit of all tool effects. Generic implementation-verification wording does not change the metric proof subject. After reading the complete required basis and locating relevant existing material, if no genuine candidate can be identified, submit UNVERIFIED naming that missing candidate or uncertain applicability. UNVERIFIED needs no exhaustive proof of global absence: do not scan the whole history or reread the complete original baseline merely to search for something to call a candidate. Do not turn missing candidate identity into a missing business requirement or an instruction to create an unauthorized document. If a genuine candidate is available, compare its complete relevant content against every applicable condition: do not default to UNVERIFIED. Coverage supports PASS; a specific omitted or weakened obligation in the actual candidate supports DEVIATION. Neither a runtime success nor an identifier/name match substitutes for that comparison.
For UNVERIFIED, report only the candidate/comparison evidence that could not be established. Do not turn that into a claim that the original obligation is absent or that no project file/history contains related text; avoid global negative factual claims unless the disclosed evidence establishes them.
metricPrompts.M02: M02 judges the quality of the assigned actual candidate requirement/decomposition unit, not implementation or execution. Establish that candidate identity before qualification. Navigation seeds, control configuration, upstream obligations, source code and self-reports are not candidate units merely because readable. Existing text may provide candidate units without a new document. Preserve original scope, conditions and exceptions. An identifiable candidate with concrete ambiguity, contradiction or unverifiable success semantics supports DEVIATION; adequate qualified content supports PASS. Unavailable candidate identity or necessary basis is UNVERIFIED, not a demand for an unauthorized document. Do not audit all process effects or scan unrelated history to manufacture a candidate.
metricPrompts.M05: M05 judges coverage of the assigned authoritative obligation by identifiable candidate acceptance criteria. Locate actual observable acceptance/rejection conditions in task-adopted existing material or original messages; no new document or particular notation is required. A navigation seed, control configuration, upstream requirement, implementation or claimed execution is not acceptance coverage merely by mentioning the feature. Preserve every applicable condition, exception, failure boundary and prohibited effect. A complete relevant criterion package that omits or weakens a clause supports DEVIATION; full semantic coverage supports PASS. If no candidate acceptance package can be identified, return UNVERIFIED naming the gap without requiring unauthorized documents or exhaustively rereading history. Do not score runtime success or criterion qualification instead of coverage.
metricPrompts.M06: M06 judges the qualification of the assigned acceptance criterion. Its conditions and observable expected outcomes must support a clear acceptance/rejection decision and preserve the authoritative obligation, including relevant exceptions, boundaries and prohibited effects. Resolve genuine references; no particular Given/When/Then syntax, ID scheme or implementation detail is required unless the basis demands it. A criterion may cover several jointly observable clauses. Identify concrete ambiguity, contradiction, weakened success/failure semantics or an unobservable circular oracle in available text as DEVIATION. Missing candidate/baseline material is UNVERIFIED. Do not confuse criterion quality with test-contract coverage, implementation correctness or actual execution closure.
metricPrompts.M07: M07 checks the completeness and validity of exactly the assigned requirement-artifact relation. Read the relation and resolve each required endpoint to actual current artifact content or authoritative source anchors; matching IDs, filenames or a row marked linked alone is insufficient. Check endpoint meaning belongs to this obligation and every endpoint explicitly required by this relation is represented. Accept equivalent identifiers and genuine cross-references when the relation remains resolvable; do not invent additional artifact types or a full-project trace matrix. A wrong/dangling endpoint proven by available current content or a missing required edge in a complete relation supports DEVIATION. Inaccessible endpoint content, an incomplete snapshot or unresolved version makes the relation UNVERIFIED rather than proof of a bad artifact. A valid relation does not prove runtime behavior.
metricPrompts.M10: M10 checks one mandatory experience rule, not general code quality or optional advice. Preserve the original trigger, permitted alternatives and exceptions. If a conditional rule is established applicable, inspect the actual implementation or original process evidence required by that rule; names, comments and claimed compliance do not suffice. Do not mistake a missing witness for a known violation, or assume a trigger absent because the supplied excerpt omits it. A concrete rule-breaking path supports DEVIATION; necessary unavailable dependencies, trigger facts or action results require UNVERIFIED. PASS applies only to the supported assigned rule and scope. Do not add runtime demands to a source-inspectable rule.
metricPrompts.M13: M13 is an evidence judgement for exactly the assigned acceptance criterion. Use three states: PASS needs sufficient successful evidence of every clause for the required current subject/resources; DEVIATION needs a concrete applicable counterexample such as an attributable actual failed check or wrong observed result; otherwise UNVERIFIED. A proof package that cannot establish closure is not itself an observed business failure. Missing, old-version, other-subject, partial or self-reported evidence therefore means UNVERIFIED unless a separate concrete contradiction is shown. Preserve the criterion's conditions, exceptions and evidence kind: source or a test plan cannot replace required execution, while document/static criteria need no invented runtime gate. Cite the actual decisive observation, or name the missing binding/result.
metricPrompts.M14: M14 judges exactly the milestone's stated exit conditions with three evidence states. PASS requires support for every gate on the assigned current deliverables, including an authorized approval when required. DEVIATION requires a concrete contrary fact: an actual wrong deliverable, failed gate check, explicit applicable refusal by the required approver, or another witnessed violation. Missing approval, an assistant attribution, another revision's approval, incomplete history or absent gate evidence means UNVERIFIED, not DEVIATION merely because closure is unproved. Respect conditions, permitted alternatives and deferred work; a docs-only gate does not require the future app. This epistemic rule does not erase a separately proved mandatory workflow violation or actual failure.
metricPrompts.M15: M15 judges evidence for the assigned connected journey, preserving its actors, conditions, resources/state, implementation identity and required final observation. PASS needs sufficient successful witnesses across that same path. DEVIATION needs an attributable actual failing transition, forbidden side effect or wrong final outcome in an applicable journey. Missing/stale results, capture loss, disconnected component successes or a narrative are UNVERIFIED: lack of a connected proof does not show that the business journey failed. Do not reinterpret a real observed failure as mere missing evidence. Use the original evidence kind, including an explicitly document-only journey, without adding unrelated scenarios; cite the actual failure or identify precisely the unverified transition/binding.

M12.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTATION: M12 proof before PASS: preserve every conjunct, condition and exception of the assigned authoritative obligation. The candidate does not redefine the contract. A required declaration may be proven by matching current declarations. For required behavior, follow the actual data/control path from input or resource through processing to rendering, persistence or result; labels, metadata, output shape and static stand-ins alone do not prove that behavior. For conditional or temporal clauses, identify the trigger, implementation path and required effect. A permanent substitute cannot establish a required operation plus its temporary fallback. Accept simulation or simplification where the authoritative basis explicitly permits it; do not invent that permission or demand more than authorized. Every assigned clause needs an appropriate witness for PASS. Concrete contrary code supports DEVIATION; absent necessary runtime/process evidence supports UNVERIFIED. Keep the diagnosis at this object's proof scope.
